opportunities.title: Great Britain Sasakawa Foundation Small Grants – UK office
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must belong to, or provide evidence of support from, an organisation or institution that is willing to receive grant funds. Applications are not accepted from individuals seeking support for personal projects, though individuals may apply if they can provide organisational support.
opportunities.summary: Seed funding for projects that bring together the UK and Japan across arts and culture, humanities, social issues, Japanese language, medicine and health, science, youth and education, and sport, enabling collaboration, exchange, and lasting partnerships.

opportunities.title: Great Britain Sasakawa Foundation Small Grants – Japan office

amount.raw: generally £1,500-£5,000, occasionally up to £6,000; travel awards up to ¥300,000 for Japanese PhD students

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must belong to, or provide evidence of support from, an organisation or institution that is willing to receive grant funds. Applications are not accepted from individuals seeking support for personal projects, though individuals may apply if they can provide organisational support.
opportunities.summary: Seed funding for UK‑Japan collaborative projects across the same broad fields as the UK office, supporting travel and exchange activities.

opportunities.title: Butterfield Awards in Medicine and Health

amount.raw: up to £10,000 per year, total limit £30,000 for multi‑year projects

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants should normally have an existing research record; preference given to early‑career researchers and those without prior UK‑Japan collaboration. Projects must involve partners in both the UK and Japan and be centred on medicine and health.
opportunities.summary: Supports exchanges and collaborations between health and medical professionals in Japan and the UK, covering scientific, clinical, social and economic aspects of healthcare.
